title: Weekly email digest notification preference
purpose: Proposed handoff assembled from source-linked outcomes; human source review and approval required.

scope.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

requirements.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

stories.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
acceptance_criteria: When a member switches weekly email digests on in notification settings, the member is included in the next weekly email digest.
When a member switches weekly email digests off in notification settings, the member is excluded from the next weekly email digest.

stories.text: The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
acceptance_criteria: After a member switches weekly email digests on, signs out, and signs back in, the member is included in the next weekly email digest without switching it on again.
After a member switches weekly email digests off, signs out, and signs back in, the member is excluded from the next weekly email digest without switching it off again.

stories.text: Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
acceptance_criteria: When a member has weekly email digests switched off, an account-security message is still delivered to the member.

stories.text: A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.
acceptance_criteria: When a new member account is created, the member is excluded from weekly email digests until the member switches weekly email digests on.

Which member types and notification settings states see the weekly digest on/off control?
How does the sign-out/sign-in flow read the existing weekly digest preference?

Which sign-out and sign-in surfaces must reflect the persisted setting?
How are account-security messages triggered and addressed when weekly digests are off?
